scope: Descriptive three-seed matched attribution of profile SWD weight10 versus0 under one fixed balanced hinge-SN training/checkpoint-selection package.
paired_delta_definition: SWD10 minus SWD0; negative distances/RMSE favor SWD10. Diversity and physical means are diagnostic values, not objectives to minimize.
analysis_policy: All three requested matched seeds retained. Arithmetic mean, sample SD and range across seeds; no generated-profile pooling, confidence-interval averaging, significance tests or best-seed selection. Per-condition counts are descriptive, not independent trials.
binding_policy: Read JSON artifacts and stream-hash best.pt/calibration.npz only; no dataset arrays, model inference, archive deserialization or identity reaudit. Compare checkpoints/maps/reports to recorded fingerprints, histories and matching source provenance. Full source sets are deduplicated by canonical JSON SHA256; provenance and shared curation metadata are likewise fingerprinted.

validation_selection.policy: Uniform without replacement per observed condition; same seed/cap/order as cli.evaluate_checkpoint.

projection_directions.distribution: IID standard Gaussian coordinates, each direction normalized to Euclidean norm one
projection_directions.reuse: Same directions across all conditions and methods at this profile width
projection_directions.hash_encoding: Direction matrix (count, n_features), little-endian float64 C-order bytes

battery_scenario.name: hypothetical_additional_battery_charged_only_from_observed_net_export
battery_scenario.boundary_policy: Independent daily episodes; reset SOC to zero each row, report leftover SOC without future-day credit
battery_scenario.throughput_definition: Grid-facing charge input plus delivered discharge, in kWh
battery_scenario.scope: Secondary application-fidelity diagnostic; no annual-operation, cost, PV-attribution or real-hardware claim
battery_scenario.observed_data_caveat: Gross generation and any existing batteries are unknown from signed net import/export

evaluation_source_qualification.qualification: Controls 22/33 evaluation provenance includes the derivative-ablation helper/default configuration extension. The recorded generation/conditioning/normalization function ASTs are unchanged; derivative_swd_weight is absent from all six trained configs and defaults to zero. Evaluation source identity is therefore qualified, not asserted for the whole package.

utility_attribution.interpretation: SWD0 utilities are queued/incomplete. Available SWD10 reports are unpaired. No utility metrics/bindings were analyzed and no effect or pass/fail claim is made.

limitations: Validation was reused for model development and checkpoint selection; this is exploratory and unseen-test performance remains unknown.

Three paired training seeds characterize this declared run package only. Selection epochs differ, so the effect includes the fixed checkpoint-selection rule rather than a fixed-epoch-weight comparison.

Calibration approximately targets training slot marginals and marginal diversity; matching those metrics is not independent evidence for learned dependence. Each frozen generator has its own map fitted with the same reference count/seed.
The same fixed calibration/evaluation streams do not characterize calibration-fit, generation Monte Carlo, validation-subsampling or future-period uncertainty.
Whole-profile projected W1 is a finite 128-direction secondary diagnostic, affected by both margins and dependence; it is not a complete multivariate test.

Battery results describe a hypothetical 10kWh/4kW additional battery, daily empty starts, 90% round-trip efficiency and observed net-export-only charging. They do not establish annual economics, PV attribution or real-hardware performance.
Curation metadata and artifact bindings are retained; exact-trace removal does not prove household independence or exclude near-duplicates. No new identity audit was performed.
Statistical control arrays are identical repeated controls, not six independent replications. The comparison does not isolate architecture or establish GAN novelty.

curation_summary.identity_claim: No exact full-trace overlap under the declared fingerprint; this does not prove independent households or exclude near-duplicates
curation_summary.validation_status: exploratory; previous validation results used the original preparation
curation_summary.full_metadata_location: Each fingerprint-bound calibration_validation.json:curation_metadata; full identity history is not repeated here.

metric_vector_notes.scope: Every numeric physical macro field, three ACF lags, battery macro field and joint projected-W1 macro. All vectors follow metric_vector_order. Exact numeric source values retained.
metric_vector_notes.distance_direction: Wasserstein, RMSE and ACF mean_difference_abs are lower-is-better; diversity_ratio targets near one; physical means and lag_hours are descriptive.
metric_vector_notes.per_condition_location: Full per_condition arrays in each fingerprint-bound calibration_validation.json, sections methods, joint_diagnostics and battery_diagnostics.

source_sets_encoding: Each key is the canonical JSON SHA256 of the fully reconstructed source-file map. Apply overrides to the referenced base; null removes a key.
paired_summary_notes: Each row follows paired_summary_metric_order; each row has 12 values in paired_summary_column_order. Three paired seeds for every row. No CIs, pooling or significance tests. Delta is SWD10 minus SWD0.
